droppedRules.why: The demo page's full-screen video header.
Moves every checkbox and radio off screen, for Bootstrap's custom labels the interface does not draw.

Windows buttons keep their raised face under the pointer and after a click; the library sinks and dithers them on hover, focus, and press (with !important), so a clicked button stays sunk. The theme draws the pressed state.
A one-colon typo of the ::-webkit-scrollbar-button rule the library also spells correctly.
Bootstrap's close button geometry; the interface's dialogs carry their own.
Draws a dotted outline on any button that has focus, so every button a mouse clicks keeps one; the theme draws the focus rectangle for the keyboard only.
Turns every row navy under the pointer, a disabled one too; the theme draws the selection on the rows that can be chosen.

droppedDeclarations.why: White text and room for the demo's fixed footer; the interface sets its own colors and fills the page.
The demo's footer placement; the desktop lays its taskbar out itself.
Bootstrap opens its menus by toggling display; the interface mounts a menu only while it is open.
Sized for Bootstrap's own button padding; the interface's buttons bring theirs.
The same for the primary button: the interface's buttons bring their own padding.
Bootstrap's menu rows; the interface pads its own, which keeps a row's text and trailing controls off the edge of its highlight.
The dialog header is as tall as its title, and the theme draws its caption gradient (the library's is !important, which would leave a theme based on this one no way to recolour it).
The theme pads a dialog itself, so its header can run the full width.
A window's page is a frame laid under its chrome, so the frame paints no face over it; the theme draws the bevel around it.
The caption is the interface's flex row of icon, title, and controls; the theme draws the Windows 2000 gradient.
The theme draws the inactive gradient.
Spacing and a grey ink for the demo's form layout; a field sits where its row puts it, writes in the theme's text color, and brings its own padding, which leaves room for an icon inside it.
